record.hypothesis: Apply shared row-wise L2 normalization to the tied item embedding lookups used for GRU inputs and positive, negative and candidate scoring, with epsilon protection and padding fixed at zero. Retain the existing embedding dimension and dot-product scoring. Constraining embedding norms may reduce frequency-driven score inflation and improve generalization. Preserve features, GRU topology, history handling, readout, loss and optimizer; implement identical normalization in inference.
